title: Begin privately, one message at a time
intro: Our WhatsApp path is designed for a simple first step: choose a topic, share what feels comfortable, and ask what comes next.

sections.heading: Start with hello
sections.body: You do not need a polished explanation.

sections.heading: Share your topic
sections.body: Tell us whether the question is about dreams, love, protection, prosperity, or ancestors.

sections.heading: Set your pace
sections.body: We will explain the next step before any session begins.
